lines.en: label undeservedfuture6:
scene sanaolderbar1
Sana’s visiting from Kumon-mi tonight. She does this a few times a year, apparently.
lines.zh: Sana 今晚从 Kumon-mi 过来。据说她一年会来几次。

lines.en: She says the bar is a pretty notable location over there now that she’s taken over.
lines.zh: 她说现在那家酒吧归她管了，在那边算是相当有名的地方。

lines.en: I asked her how Sara’s been and she was reluctant to tell me anything.
lines.zh: 我问她 Sara 过得怎么样，她不太愿意告诉我。

lines.en: Apparently that tie was severed the moment I ran off with a teenager and she just doesn’t like talking about me anymore.
lines.zh: 显然，从我带着一个十几岁的女孩跑掉的那一刻起，那条纽带就断了，而她也不太愿意再提起我。

lines.en: I don’t blame her, of course. I just think it’s a little interesting how likely she’d be to go back on that opinion if it was her daughter I took to Aomori instead.
lines.zh: 我当然不怪她。我只是觉得有点意思——如果我带走的是她女儿，她大概会立刻收回这种看法。

lines.en: Tonight’s not about her, though. Tonight is about us.
lines.zh: 不过今晚跟她无关。今晚是关于我们的。

lines.en: It’s about how far we’ve come and how much we’ve changed. Where we are and where we’ve been.
lines.zh: 是关于我们走了多远、改变了多少。我们现在在哪儿，又曾经在哪儿。

lines.en: And also the fact that this is apparently the anniversary of my wedding to Ayane.
lines.zh: 还有一件事——今天似乎是我和 Ayane 的结婚纪念日。

lines.en: Why Sana needs to be present for that, I don’t quite understand. But I’m glad to see her either way.
lines.zh: 为什么这种日子 Sana 非得在场，我不太懂。不过无论如何，见到她我还是很高兴的。

lines.en: She looks far more familiar than I expected her to, though. But I imagine that’s just one more subconsciously inherited memory that I’d be better off not questioning.
lines.zh: 不过她看起来比我预想的熟悉得多。我想那大概又是一段在潜意识里继承来的记忆，还是别去追问为好。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar2
Now please excuse me as I try to tune out this conversation so as to not let my mind wander further from this table than it’s meant to be.
lines.zh: 现在请容我把这段对话屏蔽掉，免得我的思绪飘得离这张桌子太远。

lines.en: : What about the girls from the second dorm? Have you seen any of them lately? Or did most of them move away too?
lines.zh: : 第二宿舍的女生们呢？你最近见过她们中的谁吗？还是说她们大多数也搬走了？

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, it’s Tsuneyo I see the most out of everyone these days. That’s really just because my apartment is close to Tojo Ramen though. She doesn’t get out very much from what I understand.
lines.zh: : 说来也怪，这些人里我最近见得最多的是 Tsuneyo。不过那真的只是因为我的公寓离 Tojo Ramen 很近。据我所知她不怎么出门。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar3
: Oh! Yasu too. She opened her own church-slash-charity organization thing and she comes by to post fliers sometimes. She’s, like...completely transformed since high school.
lines.zh: : 哦！还有 Yasu。她开了自己的教会兼慈善机构什么的，有时会过来发传单。她……怎么说呢……跟高中时完全判若两人。

lines.en: : I assume that means she’s not being led around on a leash by Touka anymore then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，她现在不会再被 Touka 用绳子牵着到处走了吧？

lines.en: : I don’t even think they talk. I see Touka on TV sometimes, though. Apparently her family got wrapped up in some sort of scandal shortly after she took over.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她们连话都不说了。不过我偶尔会在电视上看到 Touka。据说她接手之后不久，她家就卷进了什么丑闻。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar4
: Which means that I think I am somehow now the most successful business owner from our class! Bet nobody expected that.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我现在不知怎么成了我们班上最成功的老板！打赌没人料到吧。

lines.en: : You haven’t heard from Ami, have you?
lines.zh: : 你没有 Ami 的消息吧？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar5
: Oh boy. Here we go again.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪。又来了。

lines.en: : Akira...we promised we wouldn’t talk about anything sad or depressing tonight. Remember?
lines.zh: : Akira……我们说好了今晚不聊任何伤心或丧气的话题。记得吗？

lines.en: : I don’t need an in-depth rundown on her existence. I just want to know if she’s still around and it seems like Sana’s up-to-date on everything going on over there on account of what she hears at work.
lines.zh: : 我不需要她生活的详细报告。我只是想知道她还活着吗，而 Sana 似乎因为在上班时能听到各种消息，对那边的情况一清二楚。

lines.en: : Well, sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I don’t know anything about what’s going on with her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉让你失望了，她那边的事我什么都不知道。

lines.en: : Why not just call her yourself if you’re that curious. You still have her contact info, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你那么好奇，为什么不自己打给她？你还有她的联系方式吧？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar6
: That’s what I told him as well. But Akira is worried that she might, uhh...interfere when it comes to things with Himawari. And she’s obviously the top priority now.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么跟他说的。但 Akira 担心她可能会……呃……插手跟 Himawari 有关的事。而现在她显然是第一位的。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar7
: Awwww! Akira! To think you of all people would become such a softie makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside. It gives me hope that perhaps it isn’t too late for me to change either.
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀！Akira！没想到你这样的人居然会变得这么心软，让我心里暖烘烘的。这让我有了希望——说不定我要改也还来得及。

lines.en: : What, are you the evil one now then?
lines.zh: : 怎么，那你现在是反派咯？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar8
: Define “evil.” Because it’s not like I’m fucking an entire high school. I do occasionally overcharge people I find annoying, though.
lines.zh: : 你先定义一下「邪恶」。我又没有把整个高中都睡一遍。我只是偶尔对讨厌的人多收点钱而已。

lines.en: : Oh, is that why the bar is so successful now?
lines.zh: : 哦，所以酒吧现在生意才这么好？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar9
: Of course not. The bar is so successful because it is owned and operated by an adorable, petite, black-haired angel who everyone loves and admires.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。酒吧生意好，是因为它由一位人见人爱、娇小玲珑的黑发天使经营着。

lines.en: : Oh, so Sara’s still involved after all then?
lines.zh: : 哦，那 Sara 果然还是掺和在里面？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar10
: BIG WORDS FOR SOMEONE WHO ONLY LASTED THIRTY SECONDS WITH ME LAST TIME, FUCKER!
lines.zh: : 上次跟我还撑不过三十秒的人，口气倒挺大，混蛋！

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar11
: On our anniversary? Really?
lines.zh: : 在我们的纪念日？真的假的？

lines.en: : Ahem. I apologize for my sudden outburst.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。我为我刚才的失态道歉。

lines.en: : But, in my defense, you were there too. And you are my best friend, so surely you will vouch for me so we can join forces and make fun of your husband together.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话，你当时也在场。而且你是我最好的朋友，所以你肯定会替我作证，好让我们联手一起取笑你老公。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar12
: Here’s a better idea! Why don’t we just change topics entirely and talk about something happier than what we ultimately ran away from?! Right, darling?
lines.zh: : 我有个更好的主意！我们干脆彻底换个话题，聊点比我们最终逃离的东西更开心的事？！对吧，亲爱的？

lines.en: : But the only thing Akira is interested in these days is his daughter. And if I have to hear you guys brag about her anymore, I think I’m going to vomit.
lines.zh: : 可 Akira 现在只对他的女儿感兴趣。要是再听你们俩吹嘘她，我觉得我要吐了。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar13
: Just have one of your own! Then you can move to Aomori too and she can be Hima-chan’s friend. She needs more of those. She’s too much of a homebody these days.
lines.zh: : 那你自己生一个啊！然后你也搬来 Aomori，她就能当 Hima 酱的朋友了。她需要更多朋友。她最近太宅了。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. I’ll just have a baby with no one and then ignore the fifteen year age gap between her and your daughter while uprooting my entire life. That makes perfect sense, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。我就凭空生个孩子，然后无视她跟你女儿之间十五岁的年龄差，顺便把自己整个人生连根拔起。这逻辑完全说得通嘛，Ayane。

lines.en: : Act soon or it will be a sixteen year age gap.
lines.zh: : 那你要快点行动，不然就变十六岁差距了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s too big of a difference for them to be friends. At that point, it would make more sense for them to just elope and have a kid of their own.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那差距太大，她们做不成朋友了。到那个地步，还不如她们直接私奔，自己生一个呢。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar14
: Come to think of it, are you even seeing anybody right now? Do you even want kids, Sana?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你现在有在跟谁交往吗？你到底想不想要孩子，Sana？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar15
: No. What the hell would I do with one of those? Parenting seems horrible. I don’t want that much responsibility.
lines.zh: : 不想。我要那玩意儿干嘛？当父母看起来糟透了。我可不想担那么大的责任。

lines.en: : Neither did Akira and you see what he’s become. Hima-chan’s his phone wallpaper and everything now.
lines.zh: : Akira 以前也不想，你看看他现在什么样。Hima 酱现在都成他手机壁纸了，真的。

lines.en: : Sorry, is this supposed to be persuasive? Because it’s really just disgusting me more.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你这是打算说服我吗？因为这只会让我更反感。

lines.en: : Well, surely you at least have a boyfriend. Right?
lines.zh: : 那至少男朋友总有一个吧。对吧？

lines.en: : Define “boyfriend.”
lines.zh: : 你先定义一下「男朋友」。

lines.en: : Someone you have slept with more than once who makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 一个你睡过不止一次、而且让你开心的人。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar16
: Oh. Then yeah, I guess I’m dating your husband. I sure hope this doesn’t ruin our friendship.
lines.zh: : 哦。那行吧，我猜我是在跟你老公交往。真心希望这不会毁了我们的友情。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar17
: Come on. That was funny.
lines.zh: : 拜托。那很好笑啊。

lines.en: : You’re terminally single, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是注定要单身一辈子，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar18
: Ayane, I don’t want a boyfriend. I’m enjoying my life the way it is.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我不想要男朋友。我很享受现在的生活。

lines.en: : Not everybody needs to settle down and have kids. Just because that’s what made you guys happy doesn’t mean it’s what’s right for me.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都需要安定下来生孩子。让你们幸福的东西，不代表也适合我。

lines.en: : I just worry about you. I don’t like how far away you are now. I can’t keep an eye on you anymore.
lines.zh: : 我只是担心你。我不喜欢你现在离我这么远。我没法再照看你了。

lines.en: : You could see me a lot more if you actually came to visit, you know. You don’t really intend to keep Himawari away from Kumon-mi forever, do you?
lines.zh: : 你要是真来看我，就能经常见到我了，你知道吗。你不会真的打算永远不让 Himawari 去 Kumon-mi 吧？

lines.en: : I do. Because I’m not going back and I can’t keep an eye on her if I’m not there.
lines.zh: : 我是这么打算的。因为我不回去了，而不在场我就没法看着她。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar19
: Sounds like a job for Aunt Sana. Don’t worry, Akira. I’ll give her the grand tour of the land that brought her parents together.
lines.zh: : 那看来该 Sana 阿姨出马了。别担心，Akira。我会带她好好逛一逛那片让她父母走到一起的土地。

lines.en: : I would sooner throw her off a cliff than hand her over to you.
lines.zh: : 我宁可把她推下悬崖，也不会把她交给你。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar20
: THIRTY SECONDS! THAT’S NOT ENOUGH TO MAKE ME FEEL ANYTHING!
lines.zh: : 三十秒！那点时间根本不足以让我产生任何感觉！

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar21
: Okay! Well, I’m going back to the salad bar. Do you need another beer while I’m up? Sana’s paying tonight, so you should say yes even if that one is still full.
lines.zh: : 好啦！我要再去一趟沙拉吧。我起来的时候你要再来杯啤酒吗？今晚 Sana 请客，所以就算你那杯还是满的，你也该说要。

lines.en: : I’ll take ten. Thanks. And if you could call home to check in on Himawari while you’re over there-
lines.zh: : 给我来十杯。谢了。还有，你过去的时候能不能顺便打个电话回家看看 Himawari——

lines.en: : Akira. She is fine. You are obsessed.
lines.zh: : Akira。她没事的。你这是魔怔了。

lines.en: : You say that like she’s not your phone wallpaper as well.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像她不是你手机壁纸似的。

lines.en: : Good point. I suppose it wouldn’t hurt to just see how she’s doing. I’ll tell her you said hi.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。我想看看她怎么样也无妨。我会跟她说你向她问好。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar22
: Be right back! Don’t kill each other while I’m gone, please!
lines.zh: : 马上回来！我不在的时候你们别打起来，拜托！

lines.en: Ayane scurries out of sight and, suddenly, I’m face-to-face in isolation with a different aspect of my past for the first time since I woke up here.
lines.zh: Ayane 快步走开不见了，而转瞬之间，我第一次在独处中面对面撞上了我过去里另一个不同的切面——自从在这里醒来之后。

lines.en: It’s one more aspect that’s changed dramatically, though. Much like everything else in life.
lines.zh: 不过那也是一个变化巨大的切面。就像生活里的其他一切一样。

lines.en: And while I want nothing more than to sit here and reflect on how time changes us, I know that moments like this will be so sparing from here on out that I’d be foolish to not capitalize on it.
lines.zh: 虽然我只想坐在这里，感叹时间如何改变我们，但我知道从今往后这样的时刻会越来越稀少，不抓住它就太蠢了。

lines.en: I imagine Sana feels the same as she’s the one who breaks the silence before I have the chance to.
lines.zh: 我想 Sana 也是同样的感受，因为在我开口之前，是她先打破了沉默。

lines.en: : You two are still just as in love as you were when I met you, huh?
lines.zh: : 你们俩还跟我刚认识你们时一样恩爱啊，嗯？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t run away with just anyone, you know.
lines.zh: : 我可不是随便跟谁都会私奔的，你知道的。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar23
: Ever wish it was me?
lines.zh: : 有没有想过，要是那个人是我就好了？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I’m asking you — do you ever wish you ran away with me instead?
lines.zh: : 我在问你——你有没有想过，当初要是跟我私奔就好了？

lines.en: : It’s just a question, Akira. You can say no and it won’t hurt my feelings.
lines.zh: : 只是个问题而已，Akira。你可以说没有，我不会受伤的。

lines.en: : Then no. I don’t.
lines.zh: : 那没有。我没有。

lines.en: : Good. That was the right answer. You belong with Ayane. You wouldn’t want to do something that would tear your family apart, after all.
lines.zh: : 很好。这才是正确答案。你属于 Ayane。毕竟你不会想做出什么拆散自己家庭的事。

lines.en: : You’re being weird and scheming and I don’t like it. Is this you trying to flirt or something? Because it’s making me really uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 你现在又奇怪又满腹算计，我不喜欢。你这是在勾引我什么的吗？因为这让我很不舒服。

lines.en: : Why? You don’t think I’m trying to win you back, do you?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你该不会以为我想把你抢回来吧？

lines.en: : Saying it that way makes it sound like you actually had me at some point.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，听起来好像你曾经拥有过我似的。

lines.en: : Maybe in some other world, I did.
lines.zh: : 也许在别的某个世界里，我拥有过。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar24
: It’s always been Ayane in this one, though...with the rest of us fighting a losing battle.
lines.zh: : 不过在这个世界里，一直都是 Ayane……而我们其他人打的只是必败的仗。

lines.en: : I really am happy for you, Akira. Your daughter is beautiful. And I think it’s cute how proud and...obsessed you are when it comes to her.
lines.zh: : 我真的为你高兴，Akira。你女儿很漂亮。而且我觉得你对她又骄傲又……痴迷的样子，挺可爱的。

lines.en: : It is, in every single way, a perfectly happy ending.
lines.zh: : 从每一个角度看，这都是完美的幸福结局。

lines.en: : But I imagine it must also feel a little sudden, huh?
lines.zh: : 不过我想，这感觉一定也有点突然吧？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar25
: Like, one minute, you were in high school. And the next, you were so deep into the future that you barely had time to stop and ask yourself how you got there.
lines.zh: : 就像，前一分钟你还在上高中。下一分钟，你已经深陷未来，连停下来问自己一句「我是怎么走到这儿的」的时间都没有。

lines.en: : Where does the time go? How did this happen? Who even am I? Questions like that.
lines.zh: : 时间都去哪儿了？怎么会变成这样？我到底是谁？诸如此类的问题。

lines.en: : Sound familiar?
lines.zh: : 听着耳熟吗？

lines.en: : What’s the matter? Cat got your tongue all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？突然说不出话了？

lines.en: : Sana...do you...
lines.zh: : Sana……你……

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar26
: If you’re going to ask if I know something, don’t bother. I’m just as lost now as I was back then.
lines.zh: : 如果你要问我知道什么，别费劲了。我现在和那时候一样迷茫。

lines.en: : And that’s assuming anything can ever really be known about all of this in the first place. What with the rules always changing and...things of that effect.
lines.zh: : 而且这还得假设这一切真的有什么可以被知道。毕竟规则总在变，还有……诸如此类的东西。

lines.en: : I’ve thought about it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我想过。

lines.en: : About if it was me.
lines.zh: : 想过如果那个人是我。

lines.en: : About what city we’d have gone to or what the color of our daughter’s eyes would be.
lines.zh: : 想过我们会去哪座城市，我们女儿的眼睛会是什么颜色。

lines.en: : It’s not because I’m jealous, though. Or even that I like you.
lines.zh: : 不过不是因为我嫉妒。甚至也不是因为我喜欢你。

lines.en: : It’s just different. And it’s possible. And you never really know what direction life is going to take you in.
lines.zh: : 只是那不一样。而那是可能的。而你永远不知道人生会带你走向哪个方向。

lines.en: : But an interesting thought to think is about how there might be a world for all of those things. How, somewhere out there, that might have happened.
lines.zh: : 不过有个有趣的想法——也许那些可能各自都有一个世界存在。也许在某个地方，那些事真的发生过。

lines.en: : I wonder how that Sana feels. How that Akira feels. And if he loves what we created even half as much as what he loves here.
lines.zh: : 我在想那个 Sana 是什么感受。那个 Akira 是什么感受。以及他会不会像这里的他一样，爱我们创造出来的东西，哪怕只有一半。

lines.en: : Well, I can’t say that’s impossible, but...I can’t picture it, Sana.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不能说那不可能，不过……我想象不出来，Sana。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar23
: And...yeah. It was...sudden. All of this. Like a switch was flipped inside of me and everything went from terrible to amazing in the blink of an eye.
lines.zh: : 而且……是啊。这一切……很突然。就像我身体里有个开关被拨动了，一切都在一眨眼之间从糟糕变成了美好。

lines.en: : And now you keep worrying that the switch is going to be flipped again and that all of it will go away?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在一直担心那个开关会再次被拨动，然后这一切都会消失？

lines.en: : Exactly. It’s the second-to-last thing I think of before I fall asleep every night now.
lines.zh: : 没错。现在我每天晚上入睡前，倒数第二个想到的就是这件事。

lines.en: : The last being-
lines.zh: : 最后一个是——

lines.en: : You know exactly what the last thing is. And something tells me you also know how worried I am that I won’t ever stop feeling this way.
lines.zh: : 你很清楚最后一个是什么。而且我有种感觉，你也知道我有多害怕自己会永远这样下去。

lines.en: : What, like you’re standing on a rug that someone’s trying to yank out from under you?
lines.zh: : 什么，就像你站在地毯上，而有人正要把地毯从你脚下抽走？

lines.en: : Exactly. But why do you know that? You’re just a bartender now. We barely even see each other anymore. So why do you understand how I feel?
lines.zh: : 没错。可你为什么会知道？你现在不过是个酒保。我们几乎都不怎么见面了。那你为什么能理解我的感受？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar25
: Beats me. I think the answer is wedged somewhere between dream logic and survival instinct, though.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过我觉得答案大概卡在梦境逻辑和求生本能之间的某个地方。

lines.en: : Either that or it’s just the wine talking. I always say a little more than I want to when I’m drunk.
lines.zh: : 要么就只是酒在说话。我喝醉的时候总会说得比想说的多一点。

lines.en: : You should drink more too, Akira. Tonight’s a celebration after all. Of you reaching the good ending.
lines.zh: : 你也该多喝点，Akira。毕竟今晚是庆祝。庆祝你走到了好结局。

lines.en: : Those are always bittersweet when it comes to dating sims, though. Like you can’t help but feel bad for the all the heroines that wound up losing.
lines.zh: : 不过放在恋爱模拟游戏里，好结局总是苦乐参半的。就像你忍不住会同情那些最终落败的女主角。

lines.en: : Especially the ones directly tied to the winner — who get to sit back and watch as infinite joy so easily and constantly eludes them.
lines.zh: : 尤其是那些和赢家直接相关的——她们只能坐在一旁，看着无限的喜悦那么轻易、那么持续地与她们擦肩而过。

lines.en: : I don’t really know what you want me to say.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道你想让我说什么。

lines.en: : Nothing, really.
lines.zh: : 其实什么都不用说。

lines.en: : It’s fine if you just look at me.
lines.zh: : 你只要看着我就好。

lines.en: : I can imagine the rest.
lines.zh: : 剩下的我可以自己想象。

lines.en: : Okay! I’m back.
lines.zh: : 好啦！我回来了。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar27
: Sorry — that was all I was able to carry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉——我只能拿这么多。

lines.en: : I spoke to Hima-chan too. She just got back from piano lessons.
lines.zh: : 我也跟 Hima 酱通话了。她刚上完钢琴课回来。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar28
: Piano lessons? Since when does she play piano?
lines.zh: : 钢琴课？她从什么时候开始弹钢琴的？

lines.en: : She just started, but she’s already really good! We bought her a keyboard as an early Christmas present and she’s been totally hooked on it lately.
lines.zh: : 她刚开始学，但已经弹得很好了！我们给她买了一台电子琴当提前的圣诞礼物，她最近完全迷上了。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, is there anything she can’t do? Because it feels like she has a brand new hobby every time I hear about her.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇，她有什么是不会的吗？因为每次听你们提起她，她好像都有个全新的爱好。

lines.en: : She can’t play mahjong.
lines.zh: : 她不会打麻将。

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar29
: What a specific answer to just have locked and loaded like that. I guess you’re not wrong, though?
lines.zh: : 这答案未免也太具体了吧，随时都能脱口而出。不过我想你也没说错？

lines.en: : She’ll learn eventually. Mahjong’s for old people and her father is basically a senior citizen now. It’s only a matter of time until you pick it up, Akira.
lines.zh: : 她早晚会学会的。麻将是老年人玩的，而她爸爸现在基本上就是个老年人。你迟早也会学会的，Akira。

lines.en: : How the hell am I going to drink all of these?
lines.zh: : 这么多我他妈怎么喝得完？

lines.en: scene sanaolderbar30
: You’ll figure it out. I just hope you don’t get so drunk that something crazy and inappropriate happens between all three of us again. That sure would suck, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你会想到办法的。我只希望你别喝得太醉，让我们三个之间又发生什么疯狂又不得体的事。那可真是糟透了，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m like one more unwanted advance away from just finding you a boyfriend myself so we won’t have to put up with this anymore.
lines.zh: : 你再对我老公多一次不必要的示好，我就亲自给你找个男朋友，免得我们以后还要继续忍受这些。

lines.en: scene black
Sana winds up being the only one to get drunk tonight, which makes it all the more convenient that we decided to hold our get-together in her hotel’s penthouse bar.
lines.zh: 今晚最后只有 Sana 喝醉了，所以我们把聚会定在她酒店顶楼的酒吧，实在太方便了。

lines.en: And while she tries to drag us inside for another more physical reunion once we escort her back to her room, Ayane and I aren’t about to leave Himawari home alone through the night.
lines.zh: 虽然我们送她回房时，她还想把我们拽进去再来一次更「身体力行」的重逢，但 Ayane 和我可不会让 Himawari 整夜一个人待在家里。
